correctness.rationale: For all k>=1,h>=0, ordered-car min-plus recurrence p_i(t+1)=min(p_i(t)+1,p_(i+1)(t)-1) yields exact prefix-gap maximum w_i. The full-cycle deficit -h<=0 bounds the range, so all delay is finite. The zero-containing cyclic Lindley solution is unique and bijective with nonnegative gap vectors plus surplus-hole weak compositions; counting each car as a root proves the factor (2k+h)/k. Maximal staircase workloads yield D<=k(k-1)/2, with exactly n contiguous-block optimizers. Direct finite site updates and independent gap-prefix tests reproduce every histogram and both extremes in 32 complete parameter pairs via the packaged verify.py; computations corroborate but do not replace the proof.
